name: – Li Andersson – Annex I, after § 23 – Am 41
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text: Demographic decline and persistently low birth rates represent a structural challenge to the sustainability of national labour markets and social protection systems. Member States should develop ambitious family policies supporting parenthood, access to housing, childcare and the reconciliation of family and professional life. Labour immigration cannot substitute long-term policies addressing demographic decline.
